channel.title: The Quiet Details
channel.description: Design is everywhere in our lives, perhaps most importantly in the places where we've just stopped noticing. The Quiet Details is a weekly exploration of the process and power of design and architecture. Learn more at quietdetails.example.

item.title: The Bone Wars
item.description:
In the late 1800s, two rival paleontologists raced to name more dinosaur species than the other, and salted the record with sabotage, bribery, and a great deal of dynamite. What they left behind is still being untangled.

item.description:

item.description: Thirteenth in our run of short episodes about single objects. This one is a stack of letters written on the back of surveyor's sand charts.
